albert-park.blurb: The electoral district of Albert Park is one of the electoral districts of Victoria, Australia, for the Victorian Legislative Assembly. It covers an area of 21 square kilometres (8.1 sq mi) in inner suburban Melbourne, and includes the suburbs of Albert Park, Middle Park, Port Melbourne, St Kilda West, Southbank, South Melbourne, South Wharf, and parts of St Kilda. It lies within the Southern Metropolitan Region of the upper house, the Legislative Council.

tallyroom.assessment: Labor could be vulnerable here to either the Liberal Party or the Greens, with Labor's polling down significantly since 2022.

ashwood.blurb: The electoral district of Ashwood is an electorate of the Victorian Legislative Assembly in Melbourne, Australia. It was created in the redistribution of electoral boundaries in 2021, and came into effect at the 2022 Victorian state election.

tallyroom.assessment: The Liberal Party would be looking to gain this seat if current polling plays out.

bass.blurb: The electoral district of Bass is one of the electoral districts of Victoria, Australia, for the Victorian Legislative Assembly. It covers an area of 1,358 square kilometres (524 sq mi) south east of Melbourne, stretching from the satellite suburb of Clyde through rural areas to the coast at Inverloch and Phillip Island. It includes the suburbs and towns of Bass, Cape Paterson, Clyde, Corinella, Cowes, Grantville, Inverloch, Kilcunda, Koo Wee Rup, Lang Lang, Pearcedale, Rhyll, San Remo, Tooradin, Ventnor and Wonthaggi.

tallyroom.assessment: Bass is an extremely marginal seat and Labor's vote has dropped dramatically since 2022. Up until 2025, this seat would have been a likely Liberal gain but could be a strong prospect for One Nation.

bayswater.blurb: The electoral district of Bayswater is one of the electoral districts of Victoria, Australia, for the Victorian Legislative Assembly. It covers an area of 39 square kilometres (15 sq mi) in outer eastern Melbourne, and includes the suburbs of Bayswater, Heathmont, Kilsyth South and The Basin, and parts of Bayswater North, Boronia, Ringwood and Wantirna. It lies within the Eastern Metropolitan Region of the upper house, the Legislative Council.

tallyroom.assessment: The Liberal Party will be hoping to pick up Bayswater. It's not likely that One Nation will be in a position to win here but that's not entirely clear.

bellarine.blurb: The electoral district of Bellarine is one of the electoral districts of Victoria, Australia, for the Victorian Legislative Assembly. It covers an area of 367 square kilometres (142 sq mi) stretching from the Bellarine Peninsula to the outer eastern suburbs of Geelong. It includes the towns of Barwon Heads, Clifton Springs, Drysdale, Indented Head, Ocean Grove, Point Lonsdale, Portarlington and Queenscliff and the Geelong suburb of Leopold.

tallyroom.assessment: Bellarine is not a particularly safe Labor seat, and could be vulnerable to either the Liberal Party or One Nation if Labor's low primary vote polling continues.

benambra.blurb: The electoral district of Benambra is one of the electoral districts of Victoria, Australia, for the Victorian Legislative Assembly. It covers an area of 10,037 square kilometres (3,875 sq mi)  in north-eastern Victoria. The largest settlement is the city of Wodonga.

tallyroom.assessment: The Liberal Party barely retained Benambra in 2022, and now doesn't have a sitting MP to defend the seat.

bendigo-east.blurb: Bendigo East is an electoral district of the Legislative Assembly in the Australian state of Victoria. It covers an area of 2,711 square kilometres (1,047 sq mi) covering the part of the city of Bendigo east of the Yungera railway line and surrounding rural areas to the north, east and south. It includes the Bendigo suburbs of East Bendigo, Epsom, Flora Hill, Junortoun, Kennington, Quarry Hill, Spring Gully, Strathdale, Strathfieldsaye and White Hills, and the surrounding towns of Axedale, Goornong, Huntly, Mandurang, Raywood and Sedgwick.

tallyroom.assessment: Bendigo East is definitely vulnerable, with One Nation expected to perform strongly in regional areas.

bendigo-west.blurb: Bendigo West is an electoral district of the Legislative Assembly in the Australian state of Victoria. It is a 1,524-square-kilometre (588 sq mi)  electorate, centred on the city of Bendigo west of the Yungera railway line, and includes surrounding rural towns to the west and south-west. It encompasses the localities of Bendigo City, California Gully, Castlemaine, Harcourt, Long Gully, Maldon, Marong, Newstead and West Bendigo.

tallyroom.assessment: The Labor margin here is substantial but it could be vulnerable to the Coalition or One Nation.

bentleigh.blurb: The electoral district of Bentleigh is an electoral district of the Victorian Legislative Assembly. It covers an area of 25 square kilometres (9.7 sq mi) in southern Melbourne, including the suburbs of Bentleigh, Hampton East, McKinnon, and Moorabbin, and parts of Cheltenham, Bentleigh East, Brighton East and Ormond. It also includes the Moorabbin campus of the Monash Medical Centre.

tallyroom.assessment: The Labor margin here does not look large enough to withstand current polling, with the Liberal Party the main threat.

berwick.blurb: The electoral district of Berwick is an electoral district of the Legislative Assembly in the Australian state of Victoria.

tallyroom.assessment: Brad Battin will likely win re-election but seats on the outskirts of Melbourne like this one will probably have a high One Nation vote which could be of concern.

box-hill.blurb: The electoral district of Box Hill is an electoral district of the Victorian Legislative Assembly, covering an area of 29 square kilometres (11 sq mi) in eastern Melbourne. It contains the suburbs of Box Hill, Box Hill North, Box Hill South, Mont Albert, Mont Albert North, most of Blackburn, Blackburn North, and Blackburn South, and parts of Balwyn North, Burwood, Burwood East, and Surrey Hills.

tallyroom.assessment: Box Hill will be a key target for the Liberal Party.

brighton.blurb: The electoral district of Brighton is an electoral district of the Victorian Legislative Assembly. It covers an area of 20 square kilometres (7.7 sq mi) in south-eastern Melbourne, including the suburbs of Brighton and Elwood, and parts of Brighton East and Hampton. It lies within the Southern Metropolitan Region of the upper house, the Legislative Council.

tallyroom.assessment: While James Newbury doesn't hold Brighton by a very large margin, this is not likely to be a hospitable environment for One Nation, and Labor's position will be significantly weakened compared to the last election, so he should be comfortably re-elected.

broadmeadows.blurb: The electoral district of Broadmeadows is an electorate of the Victorian Legislative Assembly. It covers an area of 47 square kilometres (18 sq mi) in outer northern Melbourne, and includes the suburbs of Broadmeadows, Campbellfield, Coolaroo, Dallas, Fawkner, Glenroy, Hadfield, Jacana and Oak Park. It lies within the Northern Metropolitan Region of the upper house, the Legislative Council.

tallyroom.assessment: Broadmeadows is the kind of seat where Labor is relatively strong and they are likely to retain the seat. One Nation may do well here but they will struggle to be strong enough to win the seat.

brunswick.blurb: The electoral district of Brunswick is an electorate of the Victorian Legislative Assembly. It covers an area of 14 square kilometres (5.4 sq mi) in inner northern Melbourne, and includes the suburbs of Brunswick, Brunswick East, Carlton North, Fitzroy North, Princes Hill and parts of Brunswick West. It lies within the Northern Metropolitan Region of the upper house, the Legislative Council.

tallyroom.assessment: The retirement of sitting Greens MP Tim Read will likely weaken the Greens position, but the poor polling of the ALP will make it much harder for Labor to capitalise on that loss of personal vote. If the Liberal Party were to change their 2022 decision and recommend preferences to Labor over Greens, that would also weaken the Greens' position but need not be fatal.

bulleen.blurb: The electoral district of Bulleen is an electoral district of the Victorian Legislative Assembly. It covers an area of 39 square kilometres (15 sq mi) in eastern Melbourne, including the suburbs of Bulleen, Doncaster, Templestowe Lower, and part of Templestowe. It lies within the Eastern Metropolitan Region of the upper house, the Legislative Council.

tallyroom.assessment: The Liberal Party's position in Bulleen should be relatively solid, but One Nation may grab a significant chunk of the Liberal vote.

bundoora.blurb: Bundoora is an electoral district of the Victorian Legislative Assembly. It covers an area of 35 square kilometres (14 sq mi) in north-eastern Melbourne, encompassing the suburbs of Bundoora, Kingsbury, Watsonia and Watsonia North, and parts of Greensborough, Macleod, Mill Park and Yallambie. It also includes the central campus of La Trobe University.

tallyroom.assessment: Bundoora is likely safe enough for Labor to hold on. One Nation will likely take a big chunk out of the Liberal vote but will struggle to poll enough to win.

carrum.blurb: The electoral district of Carrum is an electoral district of the Victorian Legislative Assembly. It lies in the south eastern suburbs of Melbourne, covering Bangholme, Bonbeach, Carrum, Carrum Downs, Lyndhurst, Patterson Lakes, Sandhurst, Seaford and Skye.

tallyroom.assessment: Kilkenny holds Carrum by a sizeable margin but it could be in play if Labor has a particularly poor election.

caulfield.blurb: The electoral district of Caulfield is an electoral district of the Victorian Legislative Assembly that has existed since 1927.

tallyroom.assessment: Caulfield was very close in 2022, but is likely to be a safer Liberal win in 2026.

clarinda.blurb: The electoral district of Clarinda is an electoral district of the Victorian Legislative Assembly in Australia. It was created for the 2014 state election  and is represented by Meng Heang Tak for the Labor Party.

tallyroom.assessment: Labor are likely favourites here but large swings could produce an unpredictable result here. This seat is unlikely to be a strong area for One Nation but we don't have a lot of information.

cranbourne.blurb: Cranbourne is an electoral district of the Victorian Legislative Assembly. It is located south-east of Melbourne and includes the suburbs of Botanic Ridge, Cranbourne, Cranbourne East, Cranbourne West, Junction Village, as well as parts of Clyde, Clyde North, Cranbourne South, and Devon Meadows. It was created prior to the 1992 state election.

tallyroom.assessment: This would typically be seen as a safe Labor seat but they could face a dark horse threat from Liberal or One Nation.

croydon.blurb: The electoral district of Croydon is an electoral district of the Victorian Legislative Assembly, located in the east of Melbourne. It was created in the redistribution of electoral boundaries in 2013, and came into effect at the 2014 state election.

tallyroom.assessment: Croydon is a very safe Labor seat.

dandenong.blurb: The electoral district of Dandenong is an electoral district of the Victorian Legislative Assembly. It was first proclaimed in 1904 when the district of Dandenong and Berwick was abolished.

tallyroom.assessment: This is probably a safe Labor seat, although One Nation may poll strongly.

eildon.blurb: The electoral district of Eildon is an electoral district of the Victorian Legislative Assembly in Australia. It was created in the redistribution of electoral boundaries in 2013, which came into effect at the 2014 state election  and is a member of the Northern Victoria Region.

tallyroom.assessment: One Nation could pose a serious threat to the Liberal Party here.

eltham.blurb: The electoral district of Eltham is an electoral district of the Victorian Legislative Assembly. It is an outer metropolitan electorate and contains Eltham, Lower Plenty, Montmorency, Research, St Helena, Diamond Creek, Wattleglen as well as parts of Greensborough, Briar Hill and Kangaroo Ground.

tallyroom.assessment: The Liberal Party would be hoping to threaten Labor here.

essendon.blurb: The electoral district of Essendon is an electoral district of the Victorian Legislative Assembly. It was first created in 1904 after the abolition of the larger Essendon and Flemington electorate, and covers some of the north-western suburbs of Melbourne, including Essendon, Moonee Ponds and Ascot Vale.

tallyroom.assessment: The Liberal Party and One Nation won't be much of a threat to Labor here, but if Labor does very poorly they could possibly fall behind the Greens, who could possibly win.

eureka.blurb: The Electoral district of Eureka is an electoral district of the Victorian Legislative Assembly in Australia. It was created in the redistribution of electoral boundaries in 2021, and came into effect at the 2022 Victorian state election.

tallyroom.assessment: Labor is in serious danger of losing this seat to either the Coalition or One Nation.

euroa.blurb: The electoral district of Euroa is an electoral district of the Victorian Legislative Assembly in Australia. It was created in the redistribution of electoral boundaries in 2013.

tallyroom.assessment: One Nation will be hoping to win this seat off the Nationals.

evelyn.blurb: The electoral district of Evelyn is an electorate of the Victorian Legislative Assembly covering the urban fringe north east of Melbourne. It was first proclaimed in 1859.

tallyroom.assessment: Labor isn't in a position to gain this seat. It's possible One Nation could poll well here, but it would be hard for them to win.

footscray.blurb: The electoral district of Footscray is an electoral district of the Victorian Legislative Assembly. It lies just west of Melbourne, covering the suburbs of Footscray, Maidstone, Maribyrnong, Seddon, West Footscray, and parts of Yarraville.

tallyroom.assessment: Labor is vulnerable to the Greens here, particularly if Liberal preferences continue to favour the Greens.

frankston.blurb: The electoral district of Frankston is an electoral district of the Victorian Legislative Assembly. It currently includes the suburbs of Frankston and Frankston South south east of Melbourne.

tallyroom.assessment: If there is a big swing to the Coalition they could gain this seat. One Nation would poll a substantial vote share, but it would be a stretch for them to win here.

geelong.blurb: 38°09′S 144°21′E﻿ / ﻿38.150°S 144.350°E﻿ / -38.150; 144.350[[Geographic coordinate system|Coordinates]]: {{#parsoid\u0000fragment:7}}<span class=\"plainlinks nourlexpansion\">[https://geohack.toolforge.org/geohack.php?pagename=Electoral_district_of_Geelong&params=38_09_S_144_21_E_type:city <span class=\"geo-default\"><span class=\"geo-dms\" title=\"Maps, aerial photos, and other data for this location\"><span class=\"latitude\">38°09′S</span> <span class=\"longitude\">144°21′E</span></span></span><span class=\"geo-multi-punct\">&#xfeff; / &#xfeff;</

tallyroom.assessment: Labor is probably safe here, although One Nation will definitely poll a large share of the vote.

gippsland-east.blurb: The electoral district of Gippsland East is an electoral district of the Victorian Legislative Assembly. It covers most of eastern Victoria and includes the towns of Bairnsdale, Lakes Entrance, Orbost, Omeo, Maffra and Heyfield. Gippsland East is the state's third largest electorate in area and covers 27,544 square kilometres.

tallyroom.assessment: One Nation will be hoping to win this seat.

gippsland-south.blurb: The electoral district of Gippsland South (initially known as South Gippsland)  is a Lower House electoral district of the Victorian Parliament. It is located within the Eastern Victoria Region of the Legislative Council.

tallyroom.assessment: One Nation will undoubtedly pose a strong challenge here.

glen-waverley.blurb: The electoral district of Glen Waverley is an electoral district of the Legislative Assembly in the Australian state of Victoria.

tallyroom.assessment: This is a very marginal seat and the Liberal Party have a good chance of picking up the seat. This could be complicated by a strong One Nation vote.

greenvale.blurb: The electoral district of Greenvale is an electoral district of the Victorian Legislative Assembly in Australia. It was created in the redistribution of electoral boundaries in 2021, and came into effect at the 2022 Victorian state election.

tallyroom.assessment: Labor's margin is far from safe in this seat. It's quite possible that One Nation could be the beneficiary of this trend, rather than the Liberal Party.

hastings.blurb: The electoral district of Hastings is an electorate of the Victorian Legislative Assembly. It was created prior to the 2002 election due to population increases in Melbourne's outer south east. It covers Hastings, Tyabb, Somerville, Bittern and part of Langwarrin.

tallyroom.assessment: Hastings is a very marginal seat and would be a key Liberal target.

hawthorn.blurb: Hawthorn is an electoral district of the Victorian Legislative Assembly. It was first proclaimed in 1888, taking effect at the 1899 election.

tallyroom.assessment: This seat will be a fierce contest between the Liberal Party and the local independent movement.

ivanhoe.blurb: The electoral district of Ivanhoe is an electoral district of the Victorian Legislative Assembly. It is located in the north-eastern suburbs of Melbourne and includes the suburbs of Heidelberg, Heidelberg Heights, Heidelberg West, Bellfield, Ivanhoe, Ivanhoe East, Eaglemont, Rosanna, Viewbank, Yallambie and Macleod.

tallyroom.assessment: Labor is in a strong position to win the seat.

kalkallo.blurb: The Electoral district of Kalkallo is an electoral district of the Victorian Legislative Assembly in Australia. It was created in the redistribution of electoral boundaries in 2021, and came into effect at the 2022 Victorian state election.

tallyroom.assessment: Labor holds Kalkallo by a substantial margin. If there is any serious threat, it would likely come from One Nation.

kew.blurb: The electoral district of Kew is an electoral district of the Victorian Legislative Assembly. Located in eastern Melbourne, a few kilometres from the city centre, it is centred on the suburbs of Kew and Kew East. It also contains Balwyn, Balwyn North, Deepdene, and parts of Canterbury, Mont Albert, and Surrey Hills.

tallyroom.assessment: This seat will be a fierce contest between the Liberal Party and the independent. Wilson's position is likely strengthened by her position as party leader, but the prospect of the Liberal Party having to work with One Nation won't play well here.

kororoit.blurb: The electoral district of Kororoit is an electorate of the Victorian Legislative Assembly covering Aintree, Albanvale, Burnside, Burnside Heights, Caroline Springs, Kings Park, Ravenhall, and Rockbank as well as some parts of Deer Park and Derrimut in the western suburbs of Melbourne. The district's namesake is the Kororoit Creek. Often considered to be a very safe Labor seat, the seat has been won by Labor in every election since its creation in 2002.

tallyroom.assessment: Labor should be able to retain this seat.

lara.blurb: Lara is a seat in the Victorian Legislative Assembly. It covers much of the area between the western suburbs of Melbourne and the regional city of Geelong. Most of the voters come from the very northern suburbs of Geelong, including Lara, Bell Post Hill and Corio.

tallyroom.assessment: Labor holds Lara by a large margin, but the area would be prime for One Nation to gain a big vote share.

laverton.blurb: The Electoral district of Laverton is an electoral district of the Victorian Legislative Assembly in Australia. It was created in the redistribution of electoral boundaries in 2021, and came into effect at the 2022 Victorian state election.

tallyroom.assessment: Labor holds Laverton by a large margin and should hold safely.

lowan.blurb: The electoral district of Lowan is a rural Victorian Legislative Assembly (Lower House) electoral district of the Victorian Parliament. It is located within the Western Victoria Region of the Legislative Council. It was initially created by The Electoral Act Amendment Act 1888,  taking effect at the 1889 elections.

tallyroom.assessment: Lowan would be a key target for One Nation.

macedon.blurb: The electoral district of Macedon is an electoral district of the Victorian Legislative Assembly. It was created in 2002, replacing the abolished electorate of Gisborne. It was won at that election by Joanne Duncan, the former member for Gisborne.

tallyroom.assessment: Labor holds Macedon by a substantial margin but poor Labor polling could open the door for either One Nation or the Liberal Party.

malvern.blurb: The electoral district of Malvern is an electorate of the Victorian Legislative Assembly. It contains the suburbs of Malvern, Armadale, Kooyong, Malvern East, Toorak, and parts of Glen Iris.

tallyroom.assessment: The Liberal Party should safely hold this seat.

melbourne.blurb: The electoral district of Melbourne is an electorate of the Victorian Legislative Assembly. It currently includes the localities of Docklands, Carlton, Melbourne, East Melbourne, West Melbourne, North Melbourne, Parkville, Newmarket, Kensington and Flemington, and includes Melbourne University. The district has been in existence since 1856 (it was abolished in 1859 and reestablished in 1889).

tallyroom.assessment: The Greens margin in this seat would look much smaller if Liberal preferences flowed to Labor rather than the Greens, but Labor's poor polling should solidify Sandell's position.

melton.blurb: The electoral district of Melton is an electoral district of the Victorian Legislative Assembly. It contains the towns of Brookfield, Cobblebank, Exford, Harkness, Hopetoun Park, Kurunjang, Melton, Melton South, Melton West, Merrimu, Strathtulloh, Thornhill Park, Toolern Vale, Weir Views, as well as parts of Eynesbury, Grangefields, Mount Cottrell and Parwan.

tallyroom.assessment: Labor's margin is quite slim and in current circumstances they are likely to lose, possibly to the Liberal Party or One Nation.

mildura.blurb: Mildura is an electoral district of the Legislative Assembly in the Australian state of Victoria and sits within the Northern Victoria Region. It is a 37,529 km2 rural electorate in the far-north-west of the state, encompassing the regional towns of Hopetoun, Mildura, Ouyen, Red Cliffs and Robinvale.

tallyroom.assessment: An independent or One Nation could be a serious threat to the Nationals here.

mill-park.blurb: The electoral district of Mill Park is an electoral district of the Victorian Legislative Assembly.

tallyroom.assessment: Mill Park is a traditional safe Labor seat, although a strong One Nation vote could pose a threat depending on the scale.

monbulk.blurb: The electoral district of Monbulk is an electoral district of the Victorian Legislative Assembly. It is situated in the Dandenong Ranges on the outskirts of Melbourne. It includes the towns of Monbulk, Olinda and Silvan as well as some outer suburbs such as Belgrave and Tecoma.

tallyroom.assessment: This seat could be vulnerable to either the Liberal Party or One Nation.

mordialloc.blurb: The electoral district of Mordialloc is an electorate of the Victorian Legislative Assembly  including the suburbs of Braeside, Mordialloc, Aspendale, Aspendale Gardens, Waterways, Edithvale, Chelsea, Chelsea Heights and Parkdale; and parts of Keysborough and Mentone. The current member is Tim Richardson.

tallyroom.assessment: Mordialloc used to be a more marginal seat – a Liberal or One Nation candidate could potentially win here.

mornington.blurb: The electoral district of Mornington is an electoral district of the Victorian Legislative Assembly. The electorate can be described as outer metropolitan and rural, including animal farming, grape production and wineries. The district is 155 square kilometres in area.

tallyroom.assessment: The Liberal Party are likely to retain this seat, barring a strong independent challenge.

morwell.blurb: The electoral district of Morwell is an electoral district of the Victorian Legislative Assembly. It covers the regional centres of Moe, Morwell and Traralgon, as well as the surrounding rural areas in the middle of Gippsland.

tallyroom.assessment: One Nation will be hoping to take some Nationals territory here.

mulgrave.blurb: The electoral district of Mulgrave is situated in the south-east of the Melbourne Metropolitan Region. The electorate contains the suburbs of Mulgrave and Noble Park North. It also contains parts of the suburbs of Dandenong North, Noble Park, Springvale and Wheelers Hill.

tallyroom.assessment: Labor's hold on Mulgrave is likely solid.

murray-plains.blurb: The electoral district of Murray Plains is an electoral district of the Victorian Legislative Assembly in Australia. It was created in the redistribution of electoral boundaries in 2013, and came into effect at the 2014 state election.

tallyroom.assessment: This seat would be a top priority for One Nation. The Nationals would hope their remaining vote would be high enough to hold on.

narracan.blurb: The electoral district of Narracan is an electoral district of the Victorian Legislative Assembly in Australia. It was first proclaimed in 1967 and has usually been held by the Liberal Party.

tallyroom.assessment: One Nation would be a serious threat to the Liberal Party here. 2023 result Candidate Party Votes % Swing Wayne Farnham Liberal 16,741 45.0 -10.6 Alyssa Weaver Greens 4,132 11.1 +5.1 Tony Wolfe Independent 4,110 11.0 +11.0 Sophia Camille De Wit Democratic Labour 2,641 7.1 +7.1 Leonie Blackwell Freedom Party 2,254 6.1 +6.1 Casey Murphy One Nation 2,246 6.0 +6.0 Annemarie McCabe Independent 1,437 3.9 +3.9 Michael Abelman Liberal Democrats 1,325 3.6 +3.6 Brendan Clarke Family First 1,089 2.9 +2.9 Austin Cram Animal Justice 849 2.3 +2.3 Ian Honey Independent 381 1.0 +1.0 Informal 2,619 6.6 2023 two-candidate-preferred result Candidate Party Votes % Swing Wayne Farnham Liberal 23,568 62.9 Tony Wo

narre-warren-north.blurb: The electoral district of Narre Warren North is an electorate of the Victorian Legislative Assembly and includes the suburbs of Hallam, Narre Warren, Narre Warren North and parts of Berwick, Endeavour Hills and Harkaway.

narre-warren-south.blurb: The electoral district of Narre Warren South is an electorate of the Victorian Legislative Assembly, containing the suburbs of Cranbourne North, Hampton Park, Lynbrook and Narre Warren South. It has been continuously held by the Labor Party since its creation in 2002.

nepean.blurb: The electoral district of Nepean is an electorate of the Victorian Legislative Assembly covering the southernmost part of the Mornington Peninsula in Victoria, Australia. It is named after Point Nepean which is contained within the electorate.

tallyroom.assessment: The Liberal Party are favourites to retain this seat at the November general election.

niddrie.blurb: The electoral district of Niddrie is a metropolitan electorate approximately 8 kilometres (5 mi) northwest of Melbourne, Australia in Victoria's Legislative Assembly.

tallyroom.assessment: Labor's margin may not be enough to hold on to this seat, although Carroll's new status as Premier may help him. It's unclear if One Nation would do well here, if the Liberal Party are better placed to benefit from an anti-Labor swing.

northcote.blurb: The electoral district of Northcote /ˈnɔːθkət/ is an electoral district of the Victorian Legislative Assembly. It covers the suburbs of Alphington, Fairfield, Northcote, Thornbury, and part of Preston. It lies on the northern bank of the Yarra River between the Merri and Darebin creeks.

tallyroom.assessment: The Greens would be hoping that a slumping Labor vote would allow them to win here.

oakleigh.blurb: The electoral district of Oakleigh is an electoral district of the Victorian Legislative Assembly. It covers the south-east Melbourne suburbs of Carnegie, Murrumbeena, Hughesdale, Notting Hill, Oakleigh East, Oakleigh and parts of Chadstone, Glen Waverley, Mount Waverley, Glen Huntly, Mulgrave and Ormond.

tallyroom.assessment: Labor will probably hold on here, but the Liberal Party will likely make a significant impact on the margin.

ovens-valley.blurb: The electoral district of Ovens Valley is an electoral district of the Victorian Legislative Assembly in Australia. It was created in the redistribution of electoral boundaries in 2013, and came into effect at the 2014 state election.

tallyroom.assessment: One Nation would be hoping to pick up this seat.

pakenham.blurb: The electoral district of Pakenham is an electoral district of the Legislative Assembly in the Australian state of Victoria. Originally created for the 1992 election and abolished at the 2002 election, it was recreated in the redistribution of electoral boundaries in 2021, and was re-contested at the 2022 Victorian state election.

tallyroom.assessment: This seat is extremely marginal and Labor would be doing very well if they were to hold on. One Nation would have ambitions to do well in this outer suburban electorate.

pascoe-vale.blurb: The electoral district of Pascoe Vale is an electoral district of the Victorian Legislative Assembly.

tallyroom.assessment: This seat is very marginal. If Labor loses ground to the Greens in the inner suburbs, this seat could change hands.

point-cook.blurb: The Electoral district of Point Cook is an electoral district of the Victorian Legislative Assembly in Australia. It was created in the redistribution of electoral boundaries in 2021, and came into effect at the 2022 Victorian state election.

tallyroom.assessment: Labor has a substantial margin here but in such an unsettled election they would be far from certain to hold the seat.

polwarth.blurb: The electoral district of Polwarth is an electoral district of the Victorian Legislative Assembly. It is located in south-west rural Victoria, west of Geelong, and covers the Colac and Corangamite local government areas (LGA), parts of the Moyne, Golden Plains and Surf Coast LGAs, and slivers of the Ararat and Greater Geelong LGAs, running along the Great Ocean Road taking in Anglesea, Cape Otway, Peterborough, Aireys Inlet, Lorne, Wye River, Apollo Bay and Port Campbell, covering the inland towns of Winchelsea, Colac, Camperdown and Terang along the Princes Highway, and Inverleigh, Cressy, Li

tallyroom.assessment: While Labor has come close to winning this seat in the past, this is unlikely to happen in 2026. One Nation may, however, have hopes of taking the seat.

prahran.blurb: Prahran is an electoral district of the Legislative Assembly in the Australian state of Victoria. It was created by the Electoral Act Amendment Act 1888,  taking effect at the 1889 elections. The electorate is the state’s smallest by area, covering a little under 11 km2 (4.2 sq mi) in the inner south-east of Melbourne.

tallyroom.assessment: The Liberal Party's win in Prahran was very specific to the circumstances of the by-election. The Greens would have high hopes of regaining this seat at a general election when Labor is running.

preston.blurb: The electoral district of Preston is an electoral district of the Victorian Legislative Assembly. It currently centres on the northern Melbourne suburbs of Preston and Reservoir. It has always been a safe Labor Party seat.

tallyroom.assessment: If Labor's vote collapses, and the Greens are doing relatively well, the Greens could win this seat.

richmond.blurb: Richmond is an electoral district of the Legislative Assembly in the Australian state of Victoria. It is currently a 13 km2 electorate in the inner east of Melbourne, encompassing the suburbs of Richmond, Cremorne, Burnley, Abbotsford, Collingwood, Clifton Hill, Fitzroy and Fitzroy North. Historically a very safe seat for the Labor Party, Richmond has in recent elections become increasingly marginal against the Greens, who eventually won the seat at the 2022 Victorian state election.

tallyroom.assessment: In current circumstances, the Greens should retain this seat, although the loss of Liberal preferences would significantly weaken the Greens margin.

ringwood.blurb: The electoral district of Ringwood is an electoral district of the Victorian Legislative Assembly, located in the east of Melbourne. It was first proclaimed in 1958 and was abolished in 1992. Some of Ringwood was included in the new electoral district of Bayswater that year.

tallyroom.assessment: Labor will struggle to regain this seat in the absence of a sitting MP.

ripon.blurb: Ripon is a single member electoral district of the Victorian Legislative Assembly. It is a rural electorate based in western Victoria. In 1946 the electoral district of Ripon was first contested but then abolished in the 1955 election after being held by Labor for seven of these years.

tallyroom.assessment: The Labor hold on this seat is far from solid, and they could lose to either the Nationals or One Nation.

rowville.blurb: The electoral district of Rowville is an electoral district of the Victorian Legislative Assembly in Australia. It was created in the redistribution of electoral boundaries in 2013, and came into effect at the 2014 state election.

tallyroom.assessment: The Liberal Party will probably retain this seat.

sandringham.blurb: The electoral district of Sandringham is one of the electoral districts of Victoria, Australia, for the Victorian Legislative Assembly. It consists of the Melbourne bayside suburbs of Beaumaris, Black Rock and Sandringham, and parts of Cheltenham, Hampton, Highett, and Mentone.

tallyroom.assessment: The Liberal Party should retain this seat.

shepparton.blurb: The electoral district of Shepparton is a rural Lower House electoral district of the Victorian Parliament. It is located within the Northern Victoria Region of the Legislative Council.

tallyroom.assessment: One Nation would be hoping to unseat the Nationals here.

south-barwon.blurb: South Barwon is an electoral district of the Legislative Assembly in the Australian state of Victoria. Located in a mixed urban and rural area south of the Barwon River, it covers an area of 621 km², including the Geelong suburbs of Belmont and Grovedale, Waurn Ponds and part of Highton, the coastal centre of Torquay and the rural towns of Barrabool, Bellbrae, Connewarre, Gnarwarre, Modewarre, Moriac and Mount Moriac. The electorate had a population of 92,460 at the 2021 census.

tallyroom.assessment: Labor holds South Barwon by a substantial margin, but without a sitting MP an outer suburban seat like this could be vulnerable to One Nation.

south-west-coast.blurb: The electoral district of South-West Coast is an electorate of the Victorian Legislative Assembly. It was created prior to the 2002 election in order to replace the abolished seats of Portland and Warrnambool.

st-albans.blurb: The electoral district of St Albans is an electoral district of the Victorian Legislative Assembly. It has existed in 2 incarnations, first from 1985 to 1992, and was created again in the 2013 redistribution and came into effect at the 2014 state election.

tallyroom.assessment: Labor has a substantial margin, but if One Nation does very well this seat could come into play.

sunbury.blurb: The electoral district of Sunbury is an electoral district of the Victorian Legislative Assembly in Australia. It was created in the redistribution of electoral boundaries in 2013, and came into effect at the 2014 state election.

tallyroom.assessment: One Nation would be hoping to nab this seat from Labor.

sydenham.blurb: The electoral district of Sydenham is an electoral district of the Victorian Legislative Assembly in Australia. It was created in the redistribution of electoral boundaries in 2013, and came into effect at the 2014 state election.

tallyroom.assessment: Labor has a substantial margin in Sydenham, but that may not be enough to be confident of victory.

tarneit.blurb: The electoral district of Tarneit is an electoral district of the Victorian Legislative Assembly. It was created before the 2002 election where it replaced the seat of Werribee.

tallyroom.assessment: Labor will likely hold this seat.

thomastown.blurb: The electoral district of Thomastown is an electorate of the Victorian Legislative Assembly. It currently includes the suburbs of Lalor and Thomastown, and parts of Fawkner, Reservoir and Wollert, and has been in existence since 1985.

tallyroom.assessment: One Nation will hope to put in a good show here but Labor has a very large margin.

warrandyte.blurb: The electoral district of Warrandyte is an Australian electoral district of the Victorian Legislative Assembly. It is an outer metropolitan electorate and contains the suburbs of Park Orchards, Ringwood North, Warrandyte, Warrandyte North, Warrandyte South, Warranwood, Wonga Park, most of Donvale, and parts of Chirnside Park, Doncaster East, and Ringwood.

tallyroom.assessment: The Liberal Party should hold this seat.

wendouree.blurb: The electoral district of Wendouree is an electoral district of the Victorian Legislative Assembly in Australia. It was created in the redistribution of electoral boundaries in 2013, and came into effect at the 2014 state election.

tallyroom.assessment: While Labor appears to have a very large margin here, One Nation will be a serious threat in a regional city like Ballarat.

werribee.blurb: The electoral district of Werribee is an electoral district of the Legislative Assembly in the Australian state of Victoria. It has existed in two incarnations, first from 1976 to 2002,  and was created again in the 2013 redistribution and came into effect at the 2014 state election.

tallyroom.assessment: The ALP barely held on here at the by-election, and could be vulnerable to either One Nation, the Liberal Party or an independent.

williamstown.blurb: Williamstown is an electoral district of the Legislative Assembly in the Australian state of Victoria. It is a 51.54 km2 urban electorate  in the inner south-western suburbs of Melbourne, encompassing the suburbs of Brooklyn, Newport, Spotswood, Williamstown, Williamstown North, South Kingsville, Seaholme, Altona and Yarraville. The electorate had a population of 54,426 as of the 2006 census.

tallyroom.assessment: Labor has a large margin here and should be okay.

yan-yean.blurb: The electoral district of Yan Yean is an electoral district of the Victorian Legislative Assembly. It is located on the fringes of Melbourne's northern suburbs and contains the towns of Hurstbridge, Plenty, Whittlesea and Yan Yean.

tallyroom.assessment: Labor's margin in Yan Yean is very slim, and the Liberal Party or One Nation could gain this seat.
